summary: On the Main Deck, everyone is strapped into their chairs with Tank at the operator's station. Tank announces over the intercom that the no smoking and fasten seat belt signs have been turned on and tells them to sit back and enjoy their flight. He strikes the enter key, and the camera rushes clockwise over the chairs as each body reacts.
